name: runtime_reward
description: One row per epoch-reward credit to an account

bank_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number identifying this block within the current run; the join key to runtime_block. Restarts at 1 each time a snapshot is loaded, so pair it with the stream's boot id. 0 means unavailable.

slot.description: Slot in which the credit was applied

vote.description: Vote-account commission credit at slot 0 of the new epoch

stake.description: Stake-account credit during the partitioned-epoch-rewards window

owner.description: Owner program of the credited account

partition_idx.description: Partitioned-rewards partition index this credit belongs to (0 for vote rewards)

credits_observed.description: New credits_observed stored on the stake account (0 for vote rewards)

stake.description: Post-payout delegated stake written to the stake-delegations cache (0 for vote rewards)
